video_summary.overall_scene_description: First-person perspective (POV) footage showing a person walking along a tree-lined city sidewalk, entering a white Lynk & Co car, starting the engine, and driving through urban streets amidst traffic.
video_summary.main_content_summary: An immersive POV driving vlog where the creator walks to their parked vehicle, gets in, fastens the seatbelt, navigates city traffic, reacts to road conditions and other vehicles with humorous commentary, and plays music.

audio_events.detailed description: The narrator speaks in Chinese introducing the video theme.
The narrator exclaims '我靠！死腿快跑！' while walking quickly.
Sound of a car door being unlocked, opened, and a bag being placed inside.
The narrator speaks while getting into the driver's seat and fastening the seatbelt.
audio_events.observation: Voice speaking Mandarin inside the car cabin.

audio_events.detailed description: The narrator comments while accelerating through a traffic light ('喘喘喘~快抢这个灯，我直接一脚寒芒先到，随后车出如龙！').
Music starts playing in the car cabin as requested by the narrator ('来首梁博听听！').
audio_events.observation: Melodic music playing through car speakers.

audio_events.detailed description: The narrator expresses frustration at another driver ('你以为你是理想吗？？左边辣么大位置，你眼睛瞎吗？').

visual_events.detailed description: On-screen text overlay appears in the center of the video frame.
visual_events.visual_details: Yellow and white text reading '沉浸式开车上班 第一视角' with car icons.

visual_events.detailed description: The camera holder walks forward along a tree-lined urban sidewalk next to parked cars.
visual_events.visual_details: First-person perspective walking motion, pavement, parked vehicles, trees, and street furniture visible.

visual_events.event_name: Opening car door and putting bag inside
visual_events.detailed description: The person's hand opens the rear/side car door of a white Lynk & Co vehicle and places a black bag inside.
visual_events.visual_details: A hand pulls the door handle, the door opens, and a bag is placed onto the white leather seat.
visual_events.observation: Hand opening car door and placing item inside.

visual_events.event_name: Entering driver seat and fastening seatbelt
visual_events.detailed description: The person opens the driver's door, enters the vehicle, sits down, closes the door, and pulls the seatbelt across to fasten it.
visual_events.visual_details: Interior cabin view, white steering wheel with 'LYNK&CO' logo, digital dashboard, center console screen, and seatbelt action.
visual_events.observation: Person entering car and buckling seatbelt.

visual_events.detailed description: The driver holds the steering wheel, operates the vehicle, navigates traffic, and monitors the digital displays and side mirrors.
visual_events.visual_details: Steering wheel movement, road view through windshield, side mirror reflections, dashboard speed indicators, and surrounding traffic.
